description: Switch all vcpkg dependencies to static linking via x64-windows-static-md triplet. This embeds imgui, tesseract, sqlite3, leptonica, and nlohmann-json directly into the output DLLs, eliminating external DLL dependencies.
steps: STEP 1 - Update vcpkg.json to set default triplet to x64-windows-static-md via vcpkg-configuration or overrides.
STEP 2 - Update CMakePresets.json to add VCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET=x64-windows-static-md cache variable in both presets.
STEP 3 - Update .github/workflows/build-release.yml to use VCPKG_DEFAULT_TRIPLET: x64-windows-static-md and pass -DVCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET=x64-windows-static-md to cmake configure.
STEP 4 - Update CMakeLists.txt (root) to set CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY to MultiThreadedDLL.
STEP 5 - Update src/CMakeLists.txt to ensure /MD runtime and static system lib linkage.
STEP 6 - Update src/ocr/CMakeLists.txt to ensure /MD runtime and static system lib linkage.
acceptance_criteria: vcpkg.json references x64-windows-static-md as the default triplet
CMakePresets.json has VCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET set in both presets
CI workflow uses x64-windows-static-md triplet in env and cmake command
Both DLL targets set CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY to MultiThreadedDLL
No external DLL dependencies beyond Windows system DLLs are needed
verification: Validate JSON syntax of vcpkg.json and CMakePresets.json
Verify triplet string appears consistently across all modified files
findings: All changes applied. Cannot build on Linux host (MSVC + vcpkg on Windows required). Verified: YAML syntax valid, JSON syntax valid for vcpkg.json and CMakePresets.json, triplet string x64-windows-static-md consistently set across CI workflow (env var + cmake flag), CMakePresets.json (both presets), and CMakeLists.txt files (root + both targets). README manual instructions also updated. The vcpkg.json itself does not set a default triplet since vcpkg manifest mode does not support that field natively - instead we rely on VCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET cmake variable and VCPKG_DEFAULT_TRIPLET env var.
